final: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT oe.orderexecmark) as execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope
